title: No condemnation for those in Christ
english: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus (Romans 8:1). For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has freed me from the law of sin and death (Romans 8:2).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Paul is speaking, concluding his account of the inner conflict between the law of the mind and the law of sin by declaring freedom from condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.

title: Heirs with Christ and creation's expectation
english: If children, also heirs: heirs indeed of God, co-heirs moreover of Christ (Romans 8:17). The expectation of creation awaits the revelation of the children of God (Romans 8:19). Glory to the Spirit. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting and glossing Paul's words from Romans 8 about believers as God's children and heirs, and creation awaiting the revelation of God's children.
